title: Taste Skill: open-source design-taste pack for coding agents (Spanish promo)
summary: Spanish-language promo for Leonxlnx/taste-skill: an open-source agent skill that forces layout, hierarchy, spacing, typography, and motion decisions before code generation to reduce visual slop. Installs with npx skills add Leonxlnx/taste-skill for Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Lovable.
question_it_answers: How do I install a design-taste skill so my agent stops producing generic AI-looking UIs?

claims.text: Taste Skill obliges the agent to decide layout, hierarchy, spacing, typography, and motion before writing code.
claims.evidence:
Antes de escribir codigo, le obliga a decidir:
Layout
Jerarquia
Espaciado
